items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did Raymond ever tell you about that place? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No, but I don't doubt it.

ctx.x: No, I meant the dances. I didn't... I wasn't referring to any clubs, nightclubs or cabarets. At that time, well, the youngsters didn't get around to those places too often. Money was scarce for one thing, and then... Wasn't quite the place to go for a lot of them.
Did Raymond ever tell you about that place? He never played there, but the band was behind Chicken Wire, so they wouldn't be hit by flying bottles. No, but I don't doubt it.
No, but I don't doubt it.
